author: DominikEble
quote:
This game is the perfect example of what happens when a game is rushed. The graphics are good, but everything is bugged. There are glitches everywhere: it kicks you out of the screen, your character gets stuck on everything and randomly goes flying, NPCs behave strangely, and basically, it's just a "life simulator."
On top of that, critics are calling it Game of the Year. In my opinion, it's a decent game to kill some time, but at the end of the day, it's just another generic game.
